audience: small business marketers who send email campaigns with Benchmark Email

useCases.title: Check how a campaign did
useCases.text: The AI reads the report of an email: recipients, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes and rates. It compares campaigns using the report summaries.

useCases.title: Review opens, clicks, bounces and unsubscribes
useCases.text: The AI lists the contacts who opened or clicked an email, the addresses that bounced with bounce type, and who unsubscribed with the reason.

useCases.title: Count list contacts and check account usage
useCases.text: The AI lists contact lists with their contact counts and reads the plan and contact usage of the account.

useCases.title: Look up an email address or add a contact
useCases.text: The AI finds an email address across all lists, or adds a contact to a list. Adding does not send an email, so only add people who agreed to get email.

useCases.title: Update or unsubscribe a contact
useCases.text: The AI changes fields of a contact, or moves it to the Do Not Contact list so no campaign reaches it again. The API has no undo for this.
